apps/organizations/decorators.py:require.excerpt:
def require_organization_permission(
    request: HttpRequest,
    permission: str | BusinessPermissionCode,
    message: str = "اجازه انجام این عملیات در شرکت فعال را ندارید.",
) -> None:
    """Raise a uniform 403 when the active role lacks one capability."""

    organization = getattr(request, "organization", None)
    if organization is None or not has_business_permission(
        user=request.user,
        organization=organization,
        permission=permission,
        allow_any_scope=permission_supports_object_scope(permission),
    ):
        raise PermissionDenied(message)

apps/organizations/authorization.py:perm.excerpt:
def permission_supports_object_scope(permission: str | BusinessPermissionCode) -> bool:
    return str(permission).partition(".")[0] in OBJECT_SCOPED_PERMISSION_NAMESPACES

apps/organizations/authorization.py:has_.excerpt:
def has_business_permission(
    *,
    user: User,
    organization: Organization,
    permission: str | BusinessPermissionCode,
    project: Any | None = None,
    site: Any | None = None,
    allow_any_scope: bool = False,
    allow_site_parent: bool = False,
) -> bool:
    """Check active membership, role-union permission, and explicit object scope."""

    try:
        membership = get_active_membership(user=user, organization=organization)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return False
    return membership_has_permission(membership, permission) and membership_has_scope(
        membership,
        project=project,
        site=site,
        allow_any_scope=allow_any_scope,
        allow_site_parent=allow_site_parent,
    )

def business_permissions(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Expose the active role's capability codes to templates once per request."""

    organization = getattr(request, "organization", None)
    permission_codes: set[str] = set()
    context_projects = ()
    context_sites = ()
    active_project = getattr(request, "active_project", None)
    active_site = getattr(request, "active_site", None)
    ess_subject_available = False
    my_requests_workspace_available = False
    manager_workspace_entry_available = False
    if organization is not None and request.user.is_authenticated:
        try:
            membership = get_active_membership(
                user=request.user,
                organization=organization,
            )
        except PermissionDenied:
            pass
        else:
            permission_codes = {
                code
                for code in membership_permission_codes(membership)
                if membership_has_scope(
                    membership,
                    allow_any_scope=permission_supports_object_scope(code),
                )
            }
            context_projects = scoped_context_projects(
                user=request.user, organization=organization
            )
            if active_project is not None:
                context_sites = scoped_context_sites(
                    user=request.user,
                    organization=organization,
                    project=active_project,
                )
            ess_subject_available = has_ess_subject(
                user=request.user, organization=organization
            )
            my_requests_workspace_available = my_requests_available(
                actor=request.user, organization=organization
            )
            manager_workspace_entry_available = manager_workspace_available(
                actor=request.user, organization=organization
            )

    resolver_match = getattr(request, "resolver_match", None)
    namespace = resolver_match.namespace if resolver_match else None
    view_name = resolver_match.view_name if resolver_match else None

    return {
        "business_permission_codes": permission_codes,
        "party_governance_available": BusinessPermissionCode.PARTIES_VIEW in permission_codes and bool(permission_codes & GOVERNANCE_PERMISSIONS),
        "platform_navigation_access": bool(
            request.user.is_authenticated and is_platform_admin(request.user)
        ),
        "can_view_contracts": BusinessPermissionCode.CONTRACTS_VIEW in permission_codes,
        "can_manage_contracts": BusinessPermissionCode.CONTRACTS_CREATE
        in permission_codes,
        "context_projects": context_projects,
        "context_sites": context_sites,
        "active_project": active_project,
        "active_site": active_site,
        "site_context_relevant": namespace in SITE_CONTEXT_NAMESPACES,
        "context_requires_project": view_name in PROJECT_REQUIRED_MUTATIONS,
        "ess_subject_available": ess_subject_available,
        "my_requests_workspace_available": my_requests_workspace_available,
        "manager_workspace_available": manager_workspace_entry_available,
    }

    """Form for creating a contract in the active organization."""

        label="پروژه",
        queryset=Project.objects.none(),
        empty_label="پروژه را انتخاب کنید",
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Contract
        fields = [  # noqa: RUF012
            "project",
            "contract_number",
            "title",
            "counterparty_name",
            "party",
            "direction",
            "contract_type",
            "status",
            "contract_value",
            "signed_at",
            "start_date",
            "end_date",
            "notes",
        ]

    def __init__(self, *args, organization=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.fields["project"].queryset = Project.objects.filter(
            organization=organization,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).order_by("name")
        self.fields["party"].queryset = BusinessParty.objects.filter(
            organization=organization, archived_at__isnull=True
        ).order_by("display_name")

    def clean_status(self) -> str:
        status = self.cleaned_data["status"]
        if status not in ContractStatus.values:
            raise forms.ValidationError("وضعیت قرارداد معتبر نیست.")
        return status

    def clean_contract_number(self) -> str:
        return canonicalize_upper_identifier(self.cleaned_data["contract_number"])

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        start_date = cleaned_data.get("start_date")
        end_date = cleaned_data.get("end_date")
        if start_date and end_date and end_date < start_date:
            raise forms.ValidationError(
                "تاریخ پایان قرارداد نمی‌تواند پیش از تاریخ شروع باشد."
            )
        return cleaned_data

        if can_link_account:
            self.fields["user"].queryset = (
                User.objects.filter(
                    is_active=True,
                    organization_memberships__organization=organization,
                    organization_memberships__status=MembershipStatus.ACTIVE,
                )
                .exclude(employee_profiles__organization=organization)
                .distinct()
                .order_by("last_name", "first_name", "username")
            )
        else:
            self.fields["source_type"].choices = (
                (self.WITHOUT_ACCOUNT, "بدون حساب کاربری"),
            )
        self.fields["user"].empty_label = "حساب کاربری را انتخاب کنید"
        self.fields["source_type"].widget.attrs["class"] = (
            "size-4 shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
        )
        self.fields["department"].queryset = Department.objects.filter(
            organization=organization, archived_at__isnull=True, is_active=True
        )
        positions = Position.objects.filter(
            organization=organization, archived_at__isnull=True, is_active=True
        )
        department_id = (
            self.data.get(self.add_prefix("department")) if self.is_bound else None
        )
        if department_id:
            positions = positions.filter(department_id=department_id)
        self.fields["position"].queryset = positions
        self.fields["work_team"].queryset = WorkTeam.objects.filter(
            organization=organization, archived_at__isnull=True, is_active=True
        )

    def clean_employee_number(self) -> str:
        return canonicalize_upper_identifier(self.cleaned_data["employee_number"])

    def clean(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        cleaned = super().clean()
        source_type = cleaned.get("source_type")
        user = cleaned.get("user")
        if source_type == self.EXISTING_ACCOUNT:
            if user is None:
                self.add_error("user", "انتخاب حساب کاربری الزامی است.")
            elif not user.first_name.strip() or not user.last_name.strip():
                self.add_error(
                    "user",
                    "نام و نام خانوادگی این حساب کامل نیست؛ ابتدا اطلاعات حساب را تکمیل کنید.",
                )
            cleaned["first_name"] = ""
            cleaned["last_name"] = ""
            cleaned["email"] = ""
            cleaned["phone_number"] = ""
        elif source_type == self.WITHOUT_ACCOUNT:
            cleaned["user"] = None
            if not str(cleaned.get("first_name") or "").strip():
                self.add_error("first_name", "وارد کردن نام الزامی است.")
            if not str(cleaned.get("last_name") or "").strip():
                self.add_error("last_name", "وارد کردن نام خانوادگی الزامی است.")
        return cleaned
